pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which question asks "Who is that?" (1 mark)
   A. Wer ist das?
   B. Was ist das?
   C. Wie ist das?
   D. Wo ist das?

2. Which day comes right after Mittwoch? (1 mark)
   A. Donnerstag
   B. Sonntag
   C. Freitag
   D. Montag

3. What number is "acht"? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 20
   C. 11
   D. 8

4. What number is "zwanzig"? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 20
   C. 13
   D. 9

5. What number is "achtzehn"? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 20
   C. 14
   D. 8

6. What does "der Zucker" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. watermelon
   B. maize
   C. sugar
   D. cabbage or kale

7. Which sound needs rounded lips? (1 mark)
   A. a
   B. ü
   C. e
   D. i

8. What does "Danke" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. good morning
   C. thank you
   D. hello (friendly)

9. What does "Bis morgen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good day (daytime greeting)
   B. see you tomorrow
   C. yes
   D. thank you

10. What does "die Tante" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. family
   B. aunt
   C. sister
   D. daughter

11. What does "Wo spielt das Kind?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. When does the child play?
   B. Who plays with the child?
   C. What does the child play?
   D. Where does the child play?

12. What does "Freunde" mean? (1 mark)
   A. days
   B. friends
   C. foods
   D. families

13. Which sentence has the verb in second place? (1 mark)
   A. Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule.
   B. Ich am Montag gehe zur Schule.
   C. Zur Schule am Montag ich gehe.
   D. Am Montag ich gehe zur Schule.

14. What does "zusammen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. always
   B. later
   C. never
   D. together

15. Which little word goes with the noun "Hand"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. der
   C. das
   D. den

16. What does "von März bis Mai" mean? (1 mark)
   A. in March only
   B. from May to March
   C. after May
   D. from March to May

17. Which German word or phrase means "family"? (1 mark)
   A. der Freund
   B. die Familie
   C. der Sohn
   D. der Onkel

18. Where does the comma go in "Meine Oma ist alt aber nett"? (1 mark)
   A. before aber
   B. after ist
   C. after Oma
   D. after nett

19. What is the plural of "die Lampe"? (1 mark)
   A. die Lampe
   B. die Lampen
   C. die Lamper
   D. die Lampes

20. Which little word goes with the noun "Topf"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. das
   D. den

21. What is the plural of "das Haus"? (1 mark)
   A. die Haus
   B. die Hause
   C. die Häuser
   D. die Hausen

22. Which German word means "to see"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. riechen
   B. schwimmen
   C. sehen
   D. trinken

23. What does "Dezember" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. June
   B. August
   C. February
   D. December

24. What does "der sechste" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. first
   B. sixth
   C. seventh
   D. fourth

25. Which ordinal means "tenth"? (1 mark)
   A. der achte
   B. der zehnte
   C. der neunte
   D. der elfte

26. Which meal word contains the special letter ü? (1 mark)
   A. Brot
   B. Frühstück
   C. Abendessen
   D. Mittagessen

27. Which German word or phrase means "juice"? (1 mark)
   A. der Saft
   B. der Reis
   C. das Mittagessen
   D. der Kohl

28. Which word completes "Mit den Ohren ___ ich"? (1 mark)
   A. spreche
   B. rieche
   C. sehe
   D. höre

29. Which German word or phrase means "toe"? (1 mark)
   A. der Zeh
   B. der Fuß
   C. der Bauch
   D. der Finger

30. What does "kühl" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. warm
   B. cloudy
   C. windy
   D. cool

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write a menu for one day in German with three meals. (3 marks)

32. Write the German words with der, die or das for: clock, leg, house, spoon. (4 marks)

33. Write three sentences about the weather in German. (3 marks)

34. Write the German words with der, die or das for: bathroom, potato, milk. (3 marks)

35. Write the German words with der, die or das for: song, juice, egg. (3 marks)

36. Write the German words with der, die or das for: shoulder, son. (2 marks)

37. Write your own Elfchen about a birthday. Check that it has 11 words. (4 marks)

38. Write the German words with der, die or das for: hand, bread, maize. (3 marks)

39. Write in German what you do on Saturday. Start with "Am Samstag". (2 marks)

40. Unscramble and write with der or die: STWECHERS. (2 marks)

41. Write three sentences in German about your father or mother: name, age and one adjective. (3 marks)

42. Write the German words with der, die or das for: lunch, carrot. (2 marks)

43. Write a four-line dialogue in German between two friends who meet in the morning and say goodbye. (4 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: knife, balloon. (2 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: orange, lunch, carrot, grandfather. (4 marks)

46. Write two German sentences about what you would like to do on your birthday. (2 marks)

47. Write the German words with der, die or das for: mouth, door. (2 marks)

48. Write the German greetings for "good morning" and "good evening". (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Wer ist das?
   Wer means who.

2. A — Donnerstag
   After Mittwoch comes Donnerstag.

3. D — 8
   acht is the number 8.

4. B — 20
   zwanzig is the number 20.

5. A — 18
   achtzehn is the number 18.

6. C — sugar
   der Zucker means sugar.

7. B — ü
   To say ü, say ee with round lips as if whistling.

8. C — thank you
   Danke means thank you.

9. B — see you tomorrow
   Bis morgen means see you tomorrow.

10. B — aunt
   die Tante means aunt.

11. D — Where does the child play?
   wo means where.

12. B — friends
   der Freund is friend and die Freunde is friends.

13. A — Am Montag gehe ich zur Schule.
   In German the verb is the second idea in a statement.

14. D — together
   zusammen means together.

15. A — die
   It is die Hand, so the little word is die.

16. D — from March to May
   von ... bis means from ... to.

17. B — die Familie
   family in German is die Familie.

18. A — before aber
   A comma is written before aber.

19. B — die Lampen
   The plural of die Lampe is die Lampen.

20. A — der
   It is der Topf, so the little word is der.

21. C — die Häuser
   The plural of das Haus is die Häuser.

22. C — sehen
   to see in German is sehen.

23. D — December
   Dezember means December.

24. B — sixth
   der sechste means sixth.

25. B — der zehnte
   zehn is ten, zehnte is tenth.

26. B — Frühstück
   Frühstück (breakfast) has ü. Mittagessen and Abendessen have none.

27. A — der Saft
   juice in German is der Saft.

28. D — höre
   We hear with the ears.

29. A — der Zeh
   toe in German is der Zeh.

30. D — cool
   kühl means cool.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Frühstück: Tee und Brot. Mittagessen: Reis und Bohnen. Abendessen: Ugali und Fisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meal correctly written.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Uhr, das Bein, das Haus, der Löffel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Badezimmer, die Kartoffel, die Milch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: das Lied, der Saft, das Ei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Schulter, der Sohn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Kuchen / Süße Kerzen / Wir singen zusammen / Ich bin heute zehn / Danke!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the 1-2-3-4-1 pattern, 1 mark for spelling, 1 mark for capital letters, 1 mark for meaning.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Hand, das Brot, der Mais.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Am Samstag, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the word and 1 mark for the article.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Meine Mutter heißt Neema. Sie ist 35 Jahre alt. Sie ist nett.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Mittagessen, die Karotte.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: A: Guten Morgen, Amina! B: Guten Morgen, Otieno! Wie geht's? A: Gut, danke. B: Tschüss!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct line with capital letters and punctuation.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Messer, der Luftballon.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

45. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Orange, das Mittagessen, die Karotte, der Opa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich möchte tanzen. Ich möchte Kuchen essen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Mund, die Tür.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guten Morgen and Guten Abend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each greeting spelled correctly.
